learn-greetings-and-polite-basics.label: Learn Greetings and Polite Basics
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics.summary: Learn the first everyday Kreyòl greetings, including Bonjou and Bonswa, and choose the greeting that fits a simple situation.

learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-choice.title: Choose a daytime greeting
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-choice.prompt: Which Kreyòl greeting would you use to greet someone during the day?
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-choice.hint: Choose the greeting practiced for daytime.

help.concept: Kreyòl uses short conventional greetings for everyday social situations.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-fill.title: Complete Bonjou
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-fill.prompt: Choose the letters that complete the Kreyòl daytime greeting.
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-fill.hint: Complete the final sound pattern in Bonjou.

help.concept: Accurate Kreyòl writing preserves the complete spelling of familiar greetings.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-listen.title: Hear a greeting
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-listen.prompt: Listen, then build the Kreyòl greeting you hear.
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-listen.hint: Replay the audio and build the complete greeting.

help.concept: Listening practice connects the spoken greeting with its written Kreyòl form.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-voice.title: Say Bonswa
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-voice.prompt: Say the Kreyòl greeting shown: Bonswa.
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-voice.hint: Say the whole greeting at a comfortable pace.

help.concept: Speaking practice compares the recognized transcript with the authored Kreyòl target.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-build.title: Build a greeting with a name
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-build.prompt: Arrange the words to say “Hello, Mari.”
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-build.hint: Put the greeting before the name.

help.concept: A simple Kreyòl greeting can be followed by the person's name.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-write.title: Write Bonjou
learn-greetings-and-polite-basics-write.hint: Write the complete greeting as one word.

help.concept: Writing the full greeting builds accurate Kreyòl spelling habits.
help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl words and word order practiced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the complete phrase once more before answering.

greetings-start.title: Use Bonjou and Bonswa
greetings-start.bodyMarkdown:
**Bonjou** is a common daytime greeting. **Bonswa** is used later in the day and in the evening.

For now, focus on recognizing and using the complete greeting:

- **Bonjou.** — Hello / Good morning
- **Bonswa.** — Good evening

You do not need a long sentence to greet someone politely.

greet-a-person.title: A greeting can stand alone or come before a name
greet-a-person.bodyMarkdown:
You can greet someone and then say the person's name:

- **Bonjou, Mari.**
- **Bonswa, Jan.**

Keep the greeting first. The name simply tells us who is being greeted.

greeting-habit.title: Recognize the whole greeting
greeting-habit.bodyMarkdown: When you hear or read a greeting, recognize it as one useful expression. Do not translate letter by letter. Connect **Bonjou** and **Bonswa** directly with the social situation.
